contexts.text: If they have been primates of the Church (they want to dominate over all things).
When he sees the impious... made magnates and primates...
Why is this not revealed through some primate of the Church? But whether it is a primate, or the servant of a primate, is in the good pleasure of the Lord.
The magnates mean the superiors in their ecclesiastical hierarchy, who are called cardinals, bishops, and primates.
The primate (that is, bishop) looking at me, said... TCR 16.
After these things had been said by the primate...
One whom the rest venerated as their primate, because he excelled them in wisdom. (Compare CL 326.)
Who loves a primate, any minister of the Church, or canon, except for his erudition, integrity of life, and zeal for the health of souls?
There was no stated president who should act as primate among them...
It matters not to him whether he is... a primate clad in a crimson robe and a mitre of two grades, or...
The mere attribution of holiness to the Word and sacraments, when made by the primates of the clergy...
One nation were gathered about their primate...
That three primates have been thrust down from Heaven. Explained.
The (Papists) have transferred all the Divine Power... into their primates.
Redemption. 1. 9. These (four essentials of the Church) inflow into the primates of the Church, and, from these, into the people; as from the head into the body.
Like one who regards a primate of the Church solely from his mitre and the jewels in it...
